sozluk.Çarkı Çevir Kampanyası — Resmi Kurallar\: Spin the Wheel Campaign — Official Rules
sozluk.1) Kampanya, uygulamayı işletmenize ait:
1) The campaign is open to customers who use the business's own mobile app.

2) Each customer earns 1 spin per eligible (confirmed) appointment. Only one spin per day is allowed.

3) The prize is a discount coupon or loyalty points that can be used at the business. No cash, cryptocurrency or anything of monetary value is given.

4) Coupon codes must be presented within the validity period set by the business. If no limit is set, the coupon does not expire. The information in the coupon details applies.

5) The winner may not transfer the coupon code to third parties. The coupon belongs only to the account holder.

6) The business reserves the right to change the rules, prizes or wheel odds without prior notice.

7) No purchase is necessary to participate. Registration in the app is free.

8) This campaign is not a lottery or gambling; it is a promotion within a loyalty programme.
